subject: T29 CUDA benchmark - 11.5x speedup confirmed but not used (root cause: background process + DEVICE eval)
instruction: Benchmark: CUDA 28ms/iter vs CPU 324ms/iter = 11.5x. T29 training actually ran on CPU (180s/epoch, 45min wall vs theoretical 1.75min). Root cause: Start-Process background + DEVICE eval at module load + WDDM display contention. Fix recipe: assert cuda.is_available() + next(model.parameters()).device.type == 'cuda' before training. T29 result is still valid (valid_bpb 0.1556, 8.61x pilot), only wall time was suboptimal. Question to GPT: accept v2 results and add CUDA pre-flight for v3, or re-run T29 with CUDA pre-flight?
